usage: The word 姨妹 (ji4 mui6) refers specifically to the wife's younger sister in a family context.
姨妹 is a noun and is used to identify a particular family member related through marriage.
You can use 姨妹 to talk about or ask about your wife's younger sister.
This word is not used for the husband's younger sister or any other female relatives.
When speaking, 姨妹 can be used to describe someone's relationship or when introducing family members.
